meta.title: deriverge | Software studio for apps, web and data platforms
meta.description: Software studio from the Czech Republic building mobile apps, web applications and data platforms for companies worldwide. We also run products of our own.
meta.og_description: We design, build and run software: mobile and web applications for companies, an e-mail marketing platform and a data platform with a daily index of 1.7 million jobs.
hero.title: We design, build and run software.
hero.lede: Mobile and web applications for companies around the world, and products of our own: an e-mail marketing platform, four mobile apps and a data platform that reads the career sites of tens of thousands of companies every night.
live.label: Live from our data platform
products.title: Products of our own
postarna.kicker: E-mail marketing platform · Czech Republic and Slovakia
postarna.text: Bulk campaigns, automations and statistics that show what each e-mail earned. A drag-and-drop editor, segments, a unique discount code for every recipient, name-day and birthday campaigns, products from the e-shop feed and a guided move from SmartEmailing.
data.title: Public data, collected properly
data.lede: Our sources are public data and official interfaces. We do not log in, do not bypass bot protection and do not collect personal profiles.
data.feed_text: Every open job from the career sites of more than 47,000 companies on 14 applicant tracking systems, delivered daily. For job boards, HR products and labour market research.
data.apify_text: Job listings, events, company registers, sport and more. You pay only for the records you get.
data.rapid_text: Job search, domain tools, phone number validation and URL status, with a free tier.
data.tools_text: DNS, WHOIS, domain availability, Wayback Machine, phone numbers and companies by applicant tracking system.
apps.title: Apps we build and publish
apps.tapkasa_text: A pocket point of sale for stalls, markets and festivals. Works without internet, free for small events.
apps.vzt_text: A calculator for ventilation installers: offsets, pressure losses and PDF reports straight on the building site.
apps.sealslim_text: Photo compression on the phone. Smaller photos for forms, e-mail and the web; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
apps.fixbill_text: Quotes and invoices from the phone for tradespeople. The customer signs on the screen and the invoice carries a QR payment.
services.title: What we build for you
services.mobile_text: iOS and Android from one codebase, including release to the App Store and Google Play and subscriptions through both stores.
services.web_text: Internal tools, customer portals and dashboards, designed for daily work rather than for a demo.
services.data_text: Collecting public data, connecting systems that do not talk to each other, and APIs with paid plans. We run the same methods on our own data platform.
rules.title: Four rules we keep
rules.r1: We agree the scope up front. The price does not change on the way.
rules.r2: You get all of the code, including every access.
rules.r3: What we ship, we can also maintain.
rules.r4: We do not talk about our clients. We would not talk about you either.
contact.lede: Tell us what you need to build or which data you need. We reply in English or Czech.
